post_title: What will Amazon report as its Q3 2026 net sales?

question.title: What will Amazon report as its Q3 2026 net sales?
question.description:
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) is scheduled to report its third quarter 2026 financial results after U.S. market close on October 29, 2026, with a conference call at 5:00 PM ET (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-earnings-q3-2026-report).

Recent reported consolidated net sales: Q3 2025 $180.17 billion; Q4 2025 $213.39 billion; Q1 2026 $181.52 billion; Q2 2026 $200.61 billion (up 20% year-over-year, driven by AWS growth of 37%). When issuing Q2 2026 results on July 30, 2026, Amazon guided Q3 2026 net sales to a range of $197 billion to $202 billion, raised from a prior range of $194–$199 billion.

As of mid-October 2026, analyst consensus for Q3 2026 revenue sits near $202 billion (MarketBeat: ~$202.1 billion expected; some aggregators cite figures above $204 billion). Amazon has beaten revenue consensus in recent quarters (surprises of roughly +1% to +2.4% over the last four quarters). Q3 is seasonally smaller than the Q4 holiday quarter but is boosted by its Prime Big Deal Days event in October. The prior-year (Q3 2025) figure of $180.17 billion implies year-over-year growth of about 12% at the midpoint of guidance.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the total "Net sales" figure Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) reports for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026, in its official quarterly earnings release, expected after market close on October 29, 2026. The value is the consolidated total net sales for the quarter, in US dollars (e.g., reported net sales of $205.3 billion resolves as 205.3). The earnings release will be available on Amazon's investor relations quarterly results page (https://ir.aboutamazon.com/quarterly-results/default.aspx); the figure may also be confirmed via Amazon's 8-K filing or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions). If Amazon has not released its Q3 2026 results by the resolution date due to a scheduling change, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: Only the headline consolidated "Net sales" figure for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 counts, not segment-level sales, trailing-twelve-month figures, or any "excluding foreign exchange" adjusted value. If the release restates the figure after initial publication, the value as first reported in the earnings release governs.
